1.yusuf_ali: Qaf: By the Glorious Qur'an (Thou art Allah's Messenger).
1.shakir: Qaf. I swear by the glorious Quran (that Muhammad is the Apostle of Allah)
1.muhammad_sarwar: By Qaf and the glorious Quran, (you are the Messenger of God).
1.mohsin_khan: Qaf. [These letters (Qaf, etc.) are one of the miracles of the Quran, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Glorious Quran.

2.sahih_international: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
2.pickthall: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
2.yusuf_ali: But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the Unbelievers say: "This is a wonderful thing!
2.shakir: Nay! they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, so the unbelievers say: This is a wonderful thing:
2.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, it seems odd (to the pagans) that a warner from their own people has come to them. The disbelievers have said, "It is very strange
2.mohsin_khan: Nay, they wonder that there has come to them a warner (Muhammad SAW) from among themselves. So the disbelievers say: "This is a strange thing!
2.arberry: Nay, but they marvel that a warner has come to them from among them; and the unbelievers say, 'This is a marvellous thing!

3.sahih_international: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
3.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!
3.yusuf_ali: "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."
3.shakir: What! when we are dead and have become dust? That is afar (from probable) return.
3.muhammad_sarwar: that after we die and become dust, we shall be brought back to life again. This seems far from reality".
3.mohsin_khan: "When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be resurrected?) That is a far return."
3.arberry: What, when we are dead and become dust? That is a far returning!'

4.sahih_international: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
4.pickthall: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.
4.yusuf_ali: We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
4.shakir: We know indeed what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a writing that preserves.
4.muhammad_sarwar: We already know how much of them (of their bodies) the earth will consume. With Us there is a Book that contains all records.
4.mohsin_khan: We know that which the earth takes of them (their dead bodies), and with Us is a Book preserved (i.e. the Book of Decrees).
4.arberry: We know what the earth diminishes of them; with Us is a book recording.

5.sahih_international: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
5.pickthall: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.
5.yusuf_ali: But they deny the Truth when it comes to them: so they are in a confused state.
5.shakir: Nay, they rejected the truth when it came to them, so they are (now) in a state of confusion.
5.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, they have rejected the truth that has come to them, thus, they live in confusion.
5.mohsin_khan: Nay, but they have denied the truth (this Quran) when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state (can not differentiate between right and wrong).
5.arberry: Nay, but they cried lies to the truth when it came to them, and so they are in a case confused.

6.sahih_international: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
6.pickthall: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?
6.yusuf_ali: Do they not look at the sky above them?- How We have made it and adorned it, and there are no flaws in it?
6.shakir: Do they not then look up to heaven above them how We have made it and adorned it and it has no gaps?
6.muhammad_sarwar: Have they not seen how We have established the sky above them and decked it without gaps and cracks?
6.mohsin_khan: Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no rifts in it?
6.arberry: What, have they not beheld heaven above them, how We have built it, and decked it out fair, and it has no cracks?

7.sahih_international: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
7.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,
7.yusuf_ali: And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
7.shakir: And the earth, We have made it plain and cast in it mountains and We have made to grow therein of all beautiful kinds,
7.muhammad_sarwar: (Have they not seen) how We have spread out the earth, placed on it firm mountains and have made all kinds of flourishing pairs of plants grow?
7.mohsin_khan: And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and have produced therein every kind of lovely growth (plants).
7.arberry: And the earth -- We stretched it forth, and cast on it firm mountains, and We caused to grow therein of every joyous kind

8.sahih_international: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].
8.pickthall: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.
8.yusuf_ali: To be observed and commemorated by every devotee turning (to Allah).
8.shakir: To give sight and as a reminder to every servant who turns frequently (to Allah).
8.muhammad_sarwar: This is a reminder and it sharpens the insight of every servant of God who turns to Him in repentance.
8.mohsin_khan: An insight and a Reminder for every slave turning to Allah (i.e. the one who believes in Allah and performs deeds of His obedience, and always begs His pardon).
8.arberry: for an insight and a reminder to every penitent servant.

9.sahih_international: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
9.pickthall: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
9.yusuf_ali: And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
9.shakir: And We send down from the cloud water abounding in good, then We cause to grow thereby gardens and the grain that is reaped,
9.muhammad_sarwar: We have sent blessed water down from the sky to grow gardens, harvestable crops
9.mohsin_khan: And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith gardens and grain (every kind of harvests) that are reaped.
9.arberry: And We sent down out of heaven water blessed, and caused to grow thereby gardens and grain of harvest

10.sahih_international: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
10.pickthall: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,
10.yusuf_ali: And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
10.shakir: And the tall palm-trees having spadices closely set one above another,
10.muhammad_sarwar: and tall palm-trees with clusters of dates
10.mohsin_khan: And tall date-palms, with ranged clusters;
10.arberry: and tall palm-trees with spathes compact,

11.sahih_international: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
11.pickthall: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.
11.yusuf_ali: As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
11.shakir: A sustenance for the servants, and We give life thereby to a dead land; thus is the rising.
11.muhammad_sarwar: as sustenance for My servants. With this We have brought the dead land back to life. Thus, will also be your resurrection.
11.mohsin_khan: A provision for (Allah's) slaves. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the resurrection (of the dead).
11.arberry: a provision for the servants, and thereby We revived a land that was dead. Even so is the coming forth.

12.sahih_international: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
12.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,
12.yusuf_ali: Before them was denied (the Hereafter) by the People of Noah, the Companions of the Rass, the Thamud,
12.shakir: (Others) before them rejected (prophets): the people of Nuh and the dwellers of Ar-Rass and Samood,
12.muhammad_sarwar: The people of Noah, dwellers of the Ra's, Thamud,
12.mohsin_khan: Denied before them (i.e. these pagans of Makkah who denied you, O Muhammad SAW) the people of Nuh (Noah), and the dwellers of Rass, and the Thamud,
12.arberry: Cried lies before them the people of Noah and the men of Er-Rass, and Thamood,

13.sahih_international: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
13.pickthall: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
13.yusuf_ali: The 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brethren of Lut,
13.shakir: And Ad and Firon and Lut's brethren,
13.mohsin_khan: And 'Ad, and Fir'aun (Pharaoh), and the brethren of Lout (Lot),
13.arberry: and Ad and Pharaoh, the brothers of Lot,

14.sahih_international: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
14.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.
14.yusuf_ali: The Companions of the Wood, and the People of Tubba'; each one (of them) rejected the messengers, and My warning was duly fulfilled (in them).
14.shakir: And the dwellers of the grove and the people of Tuba; all rejected the apostles, so My threat came to pass.
14.muhammad_sarwar: dwellers of the forest, and the people of Tubba had all rejected the Prophets. Thus, they became subject to Our torment.
14.mohsin_khan: And the dwellers of the Wood, and the people of Tubba'; everyone of them denied (their) Messengers, so My Threat took effect.
14.arberry: the men of the Thicket, the people of Tubba'. Every one cried lies to the Messengers, and My threat came true.

15.sahih_international: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
15.pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
15.yusuf_ali: Were We then weary with the first Creation, that they should be in confused doubt about a new Creation?
15.shakir: Were We then fatigued with the first creation? Yet are they in doubt with regard to a new creation.
15.muhammad_sarwar: Did We fail to accomplish the first creation? Of course, We did not; We have all power over all things. Yet they are confused about a new creation.
15.mohsin_khan: Were We then tired with the first creation? Nay, They are in confused doubt about a new creation (i.e. Resurrection)?
15.arberry: What, were We wearied by the first creation? No indeed; but they are in uncertainty as to the new creation.

16.sahih_international: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
16.pickthall: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
16.yusuf_ali: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
16.shakir: And certainly We created man, and We know what his mind suggests to him, and We are nearer to him than his life-vein.
16.muhammad_sarwar: We swear that We have created the human being and We know what his soul whispers to him. We are closer to him than even his jugular vein.
16.mohsin_khan: And indeed We have created man, and We know what his ownself whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein (by Our Knowledge).
16.arberry: We indeed created man; and We know what his soul whispers within him, and We are nearer to him than the jugular vein.

17.sahih_international: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
17.pickthall: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,
17.yusuf_ali: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
17.shakir: When the two receivers receive, sitting on the right and on the left.
17.muhammad_sarwar: Since the two scribes are sitting on each of his shoulders, he does not utter a word which is not recorded immediately by the watchful scribes.
17.mohsin_khan: (Remember!) that the two receivers (recording angels) receive (each human being after he or she has attained the age of puberty), one sitting on the right and one on the left (to note his or her actions).
17.arberry: When the two angels meet together, sitting one on the right, and one on the left,

18.sahih_international: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
18.pickthall: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.
18.yusuf_ali: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
18.shakir: He utters not a word but there is by him a watcher at hand.
18.muhammad_sarwar: The human being will certainly experience the agony of death
18.mohsin_khan: Not a word does he (or she) utter, but there is a watcher by him ready (to record it).
18.arberry: not a word he utters, but by him is an observer ready.

19.sahih_international: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
19.pickthall: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.
19.yusuf_ali: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
19.shakir: And the stupor of death will come in truth; that is what you were trying to escape.
19.muhammad_sarwar: and (the human being will be told), "This is what you had been trying to run away from".
19.mohsin_khan: And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding!"
19.arberry: And death's agony comes in truth; that is what thou wast shunning!

20.sahih_international: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
20.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
20.yusuf_ali: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
20.shakir: And the trumpet shall be blown; that is the day of the threatening.
20.muhammad_sarwar: The trumpet will certainly be sounded. This will be the day (about which you) were threatened.
20.mohsin_khan: And the Trumpet will be blown, that will be the Day whereof warning (had been given) (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).
20.arberry: And the Trumpet shall be blown; that is the Day of the Threat.

21.sahih_international: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
21.pickthall: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.
21.yusuf_ali: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
21.shakir: And every soul shall come, with it a driver and a witness.
21.muhammad_sarwar: Every soul will be accompanied (by an angel) behind him and another as a witness.
21.mohsin_khan: And every person will come forth along with an (angel) to drive (him), and an (angel) to bear witness.
21.arberry: And every soul shall come, and with it a driver and a witness.

22.sahih_international: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
22.pickthall: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
22.yusuf_ali: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
22.shakir: Certainly you were heedless of it, but now We have removed from you your veil, so your sight today is sharp.
22.muhammad_sarwar: (He will be told), "You were completely heedless of this day. We have removed the veil from your eyes and your vision will now be sharp and strong".
22.mohsin_khan: (It will be said to the sinners): "Indeed you were heedless of this, now We have removed your covering, and sharp is your sight this Day!"
22.arberry: 'Thou wast heedless of this; therefore We have now removed from thee thy covering, and so thy sight today is piercing.'

23.sahih_international: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
23.pickthall: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
23.yusuf_ali: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
23.shakir: And his companions shall say: This is what is ready with me.
23.muhammad_sarwar: His (angelic) companion will say, "(Lord), the record of his deeds is with me and is all ready".
23.mohsin_khan: And his companion (angel) will say: "Here is (this Record) ready with me!"
23.arberry: And his comrade shall say, 'This is what I have, made ready.'

24.sahih_international: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
24.pickthall: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
24.yusuf_ali: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of Allah)!-
24.shakir: Do cast into hell every ungrateful, rebellious one,
24.muhammad_sarwar: (They will be told,) "Throw into hell every persistent disbelievers,
24.mohsin_khan: (And it will be said): "Both of you throw (Order from Allah to the two angels) into Hell, every stubborn disbeliever (in the Oneness of Allah, in His Messengers, etc.).
24.arberry: 'Cast, you twain, into Gehenna every froward unbeliever,

25.sahih_international: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
25.yusuf_ali: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
25.shakir: Forbidder of good, exceeder of limits, doubter,
25.muhammad_sarwar: who is an opponent of good, a suspicious transgressor
25.arberry: every hinderer of the good, transgressor, disquieter,

26.sahih_international: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
26.pickthall: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
26.yusuf_ali: "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
26.shakir: Who sets up another god with Allah, so do cast him into severe chastisement.
26.muhammad_sarwar: and an idol worshipper. Throw him into severe torment".
26.mohsin_khan: "Who set up another ilah (god) with Allah, then (both of you) cast him in the severe torment."
26.arberry: who set up with God another god; therefore, you twain, cast him into the terrible chastisement.'

27.sahih_international: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
27.pickthall: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
27.yusuf_ali: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
27.shakir: His companion will say: Our Lord! I did not lead him into inordinacy but he himself was in a great error.
27.muhammad_sarwar: His satanic companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not mislead him, but he himself went astray".
27.mohsin_khan: His companion (Satan devil)] will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgress, (in disbelief, oppression, and evil deeds) but he was himself in error far astray."
27.arberry: And his comrade shall say, 'Our Lord, I made him not insolent, but he was in far error.'

28.sahih_international: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
28.pickthall: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
28.yusuf_ali: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
28.shakir: He will say: Do not quarrel in My presence, and indeed I gave you the threatening beforehand:
28.muhammad_sarwar: The Lord will say, "Do not argue in My presence; I had certainly sent you a warning.
28.mohsin_khan: Allah will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already, in advance, sent you the threat.
28.arberry: He shall say, 'Dispute not before Me! For I sent you beforehand -- the threat.

29.sahih_international: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
29.pickthall: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.
29.yusuf_ali: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
29.shakir: My word shall not be changed, nor am I in the least unjust to the servants.
29.muhammad_sarwar: No word is to be exchanged in My presence. I am not unjust to My servants".
29.mohsin_khan: The Sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust (to the least) to the slaves."
29.arberry: The Word is not changed with Me; I wrong not My servants.'

30.sahih_international: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
30.pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
30.yusuf_ali: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
30.shakir: On the day that We will say to hell: Are you filled up? And it will say: Are there any more?
30.muhammad_sarwar: On that day We shall ask hell, "Are you full?" It will say, "Are there any more?"
30.mohsin_khan: On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled?" It will say: "Are there any more (to come)?"
30.arberry: Upon the day We shall say unto Gehenna, 'Art thou filled?' And it shall say, 'Are there any more to come?'

31.sahih_international: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
31.pickthall: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
31.yusuf_ali: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
31.shakir: And the garden shall be brought near to those who guard (against evil), not far off:
31.muhammad_sarwar: Paradise will be brought near for the pious ones
31.mohsin_khan: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) not far off.
31.arberry: And Paradise shall be brought forward to the godfearing, not afar:

32.sahih_international: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
32.pickthall: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,
32.yusuf_ali: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to Allah) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
32.shakir: This is what you were promised, (it is) for every one who turns frequently (to Allah), keeps (His limits);
32.muhammad_sarwar: (and they will be told), "This is what you were promised. It is for everyone who turned in repentance to God, kept his promise,
32.mohsin_khan: (It will be said): "This is what you were promised, - (it is) for those oft-returning (to Allah) in sincere repentance, and those who preserve their covenant with Allah (by obeying Him in all what He has ordered, and worship none but Allah Alone, i.e. follow Allah's Religion, Islamic Monotheism).
32.arberry: 'This is that you were promised; it is for every mindful penitent.'

33.sahih_international: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
33.pickthall: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.
33.yusuf_ali: "Who feared (Allah) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
33.shakir: Who fears the Beneficent Allah in secret and comes with a penitent heart:
33.muhammad_sarwar: feared the Beneficent God in secret, and turned to Him with a repenting heart".
33.mohsin_khan: "Who feared the Most Beneficent (Allah) in the Ghaib (unseen): (i.e. in this worldly life before seeing and meeting Him), and brought a heart turned in repentance (to Him - and absolutely free from each and every kind of polytheism),
33.arberry: Whosoever fears the All-merciful in the Unseen, and comes with a penitent heart:

34.sahih_international: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
34.pickthall: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
34.yusuf_ali: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
34.shakir: Enter it in peace, that is the day of abiding.
34.muhammad_sarwar: (They will be told), "Enter Paradise in peace and, therein, you will live forever".
34.mohsin_khan: "Enter you therein in peace and security; this is a Day of eternal life!"
34.arberry: 'Enter it in peace! This is the Day of Eternity.'

35.sahih_international: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
35.pickthall: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.
35.yusuf_ali: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
35.shakir: They have therein what they wish and with Us is more yet.
35.muhammad_sarwar: They will have therein whatever they want and will receive from Us more rewards
35.mohsin_khan: There they will have all that they desire, and We have more (for them, i.e. a glance at the All-Mighty, All-Majestic).
35.arberry: Therein they shall have whatever they will; and with Us there is yet more.

36.sahih_international: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
36.pickthall: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?
36.yusuf_ali: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
36.shakir: And how many a generation did We destroy before them who were mightier in prowess than they, so they went about and about in the lands. Is there a place of refuge?
36.muhammad_sarwar: How many an ancient town who were much stronger than them (unbelievers) did We destroy. (In vain), they wandered through the land in search of a place of refuge from Our torment.
36.mohsin_khan: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them, who were stronger in power than them, and (when Our Torment came) they ran for a refuge in the land! Could they find any place of refuge (for them to save themselves from destruction)?
36.arberry: How many a generation We destroyed before them that was stronger in valour than they, then they searched about in the land; was there any asylum?

37.sahih_international: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
37.pickthall: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
37.yusuf_ali: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
37.shakir: Most surely there is a reminder in this for him who has a heart or he gives ear and is a witness.
37.muhammad_sarwar: This is a reminder for everyone who understands, listens, and sees.
37.mohsin_khan: Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.
37.arberry: Surely in that there is a reminder to him who has a heart, or will give ear with a present mind.

38.sahih_international: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
38.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
38.yusuf_ali: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
38.shakir: And certainly We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six periods and there touched Us not any fatigue.
38.muhammad_sarwar: We created the heavens, the earth, and all that is between them in six days without experiencing any fatigue.
38.mohsin_khan: And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.
38.arberry: We created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, and no weariness touched Us.

39.sahih_international: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
39.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
39.yusuf_ali: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
39.shakir: Therefore be patient of what they say, and sing the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the setting.
39.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), exercise patience against what they say. Glorify your Lord with His praise before sunrise and sunset.
39.mohsin_khan: So bear with patience (O Muhammad SAW) all that they say, and glorify the Praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting (i.e. the Fajr, Zuhr, and 'Asr prayers).
39.arberry: So be thou patient under what they say, and proclaim thy Lord's praise before the rising of the sun, and before its setting,

40.sahih_international: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
40.pickthall: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.
40.yusuf_ali: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
40.shakir: And glorify Him in the night and after the prayers.
40.muhammad_sarwar: Glorify Him during the night and also glorify Him after prostration.
40.mohsin_khan: And during a part of the night (also), glorify His praises (i.e. Maghrib and 'Isha prayers), and (so likewise) after the prayers [As-Sunnah, Nawafil optional and additional prayers, and also glorify, praise and magnify Allah - Subhan Allah, Alhamdu lillah, Allahu-Akbar].
40.arberry: and proclaim thy Lord's praise in the night, and at the ends of the prostrations.

41.sahih_international: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
41.pickthall: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
41.yusuf_ali: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
41.shakir: And listen on the day when the crier shall cry from a near place
41.muhammad_sarwar: Wait for the day when the trumpet will be sounded from a nearby place.
41.mohsin_khan: And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place,
41.arberry: And listen thou for the day when the caller shall call from a near place.

42.sahih_international: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
42.pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
42.yusuf_ali: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
42.shakir: The day when they shall hear the cry in truth; that is the day of coming forth.
42.muhammad_sarwar: On that day they will certainly hear the sound of the trumpet and that will be the Day of Resurrection.
42.mohsin_khan: The Day when they will hear As-Saihah (shout, etc.) in truth, that will be the Day of coming out (from the graves i.e. the Day of Resurrection).
42.arberry: On the day they hear the Cry in truth, that is the day of coming forth.

43.sahih_international: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
43.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.
43.yusuf_ali: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
43.shakir: Surely We give life and cause to die, and to Us is the eventual coming;
43.muhammad_sarwar: We give life and cause things to die. To Us all things will return.
43.mohsin_khan: Verily, We it is Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return,
43.arberry: It is We who give life, and make to die, and to Us is the homecoming.

44.sahih_international: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
44.pickthall: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
44.yusuf_ali: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
44.shakir: The day on which the earth shall cleave asunder under them, they will make haste; that is a gathering together easy to Us.
44.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when the earth is rent asunder, they will quickly come out of their graves. This is how easy it is for Us to bring about the Day of Resurrection.
44.mohsin_khan: On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them, (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.
44.arberry: Upon the day when the earth is split asunder from about them as they hasten forth; that is a mustering easy for Us.

45.sahih_international: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
45.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
45.yusuf_ali: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!
45.shakir: We know best what they say, and you are not one to compel them; therefore remind him by means of the Quran who fears My threat.
45.muhammad_sarwar: We know best what they say and you cannot compel them. Remind, by way of the Quran, those who have fear of My warnings.
45.mohsin_khan: We know of best what they say; and you (O Muhammad SAW) are not a tyrant over them (to force them to Belief). But warn by the Quran, him who fears My Threat.
45.arberry: We know very well what they say; thou art not a tyrant over them. Therefore remind by the Koran him who fears My threat.
